## Why This Is Asked
This question tests your ability to design secure, scalable streaming architectures with strict multi-tenancy requirements, regulatory compliance, and comprehensive data governance across distributed systems.

## Key Concepts
- Cross-region Pub/Sub with Dataflow orchestration for high availability
- Per-tenant CMEK encryption ensuring data isolation and security
- Real-time PII masking during stream processing
- End-to-end data lineage through Data Catalog integration
- Data Exchange publishing for secure data sharing
- Schema validation and contract enforcement
- Time travel capabilities for audit and rollback scenarios

## Code Example
```javascript
function mask(record) {
  // Real-time PII masking in Dataflow DoFn
  if (record.ssn) record.ssn = '***-**-****';
  if (record.email) record.email = record.email.replace(/(.{2}).*@/, '$1***@');
  return record;
}
```
